description: Laboratory Analyst Position Summary The Technical Center is seeking a Laboratory Analyst to support testing and quality evaluation activities across multiple laboratory groups, including Analytical Testing, Microbiology, Stability, and Materials Testing. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates and early-career scientists to gain hands-on experience with laboratory techniques, instrumentation, and quality testing in a fast-paced environment. Candidates with laboratory experience through coursework, undergraduate research, internships, co-ops, or industry experience are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Perform laboratory testing and analysis to support product quality, research, and regulatory requirements. Prepare samples, reagents, standards, and testing materials according to laboratory procedures. Collect, analyze, document, and communicate test results accurately. Support testing activities in analytical chemistry, microbiology, stability, and materials laboratories. Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory equipment and instrumentation as trained. Maintain laboratory records and documentation in accordance with quality requirements. Collaborate with scientists, analysts, and cross-functional teams to support testing priorities and projects. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and assist with multiple testing assignments. Follow all laboratory safety, quality, and environmental procedures. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, Food Science, Biotechnology, Environmental Science, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, Animal Science, or a related scientific discipline. Laboratory experience through academic coursework, undergraduate research, internships, co-ops, or industry experience. Basic understanding of laboratory techniques, scientific principles, and good laboratory practices. Strong attention to detail, organization, and documentation skills. Effective communication and teamwork abilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with laboratory techniques such as HPLC, GC, wet chemistry, titrations, UV-Vis spectroscopy, microbiological testing, or materials testing. Experience in food, beverage, consumer products, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, environmental, or manufacturing laboratories. Familiarity with laboratory instrumentation, troubleshooting, data analysis, or LIMS systems. Interest in quality testing, product development, manufacturing support, or scientific operations. What You'll Gain Hands-on experience with laboratory instrumentation, testing methods, and data analysis. Exposure to analytical chemistry, microbiology, stability testing, and materials characterization. Cross-training opportunities across multiple laboratory functions. Mentorship from experienced scientists and analysts. Career development opportunities within laboratory, quality, and technic

QC Analyst Job Description The QC Analyst supports both the Quality Control (QC) Lab and the Feed Lab by performing supplemental product testing and feed sample analysis to handle increased sample volumes. This role focuses on wet chemistry, general laboratory testing, and feed analysis while strictly following GMP and GDP guidelines to ensure accurate, reliable data and timely reporting. Responsibilities Perform wet chemistry and general laboratory product testing in the QC Lab, including sieve analysis, thin layer chromatography, and loss on drying using vacuum ovens. Conduct high-throughput testing, completing approximately 12 to 16 tests per day, while managing weighing and sample preparation for materials ranging from 50 mg to 1 g. Accurately document all product testing results in a lab notebook, adhering to GMP and GDP documentation standards. Receive and log feed samples in the Feed Lab, ensuring proper tracking and chain of custody. Carry out sample preparation for feed analysis, including grinding, weighing, and solution preparation. Analyze customer feed samples using HPLC, column chromatography, and UV-Vis techniques in accordance with established procedures. Record feed analysis results following GMP guidelines and report final results to leadership in a clear and timely manner. Manage a typical feed sample load of approximately 16 samples per day, with flexibility to handle increased volumes during busier periods such as late summer. Follow all established procedures, systems, and methods without making unapproved process changes, ensuring consistency and compliance. Collaborate effectively with both a small team in the Feed Lab and a larger QC team, contributing to a positive and cooperative work environment. Learn new methods, instruments, and workflows quickly, applying training to maintain high testing throughput and quality. Maintain laboratory cleanliness and organization, including proper handling of glassware and samples as needed. Essential Skills Hands-on experience with wet chemistry and general laboratory testing techniques. Proficiency in sieve analysis, thin layer chromatography, and loss on drying (LOD) using vacuum ovens. Ability to perform high-throughput testing, managing 12 to 16 tests per day while maintaining accuracy and quality. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to record data in lab notebooks in full compliance with GMP and GDP standards. Experience with feed sample preparation, including grinding, weighing, and solution preparation. Practical experience analyzing samples using HPLC, column chromatography, and UV-Vis. Understanding and application of GMP guidelines in a QC laboratory environment. BS in Chemistry (ACS-accredited degree) with hands-on undergraduate research experience, preferably involving column chromatography, HPLC, or UV-Vis, or up to 6 months of experience in a QC lab (for the first position). Clinical Lab Analyst – Newborn Screening (Overnight Shift) Job Description This role performs high-complexity newborn screening testing on dried blood spot specimens to help identify infants at risk for inherited conditions. You will operate a variety of analytical methods, ensure accurate and timely test results, and support quality assurance activities in a 24/7 laboratory that processes newborn samples from multiple states. This position plays a critical role in enabling early diagnosis and treatment for newborns who may require urgent medical care. Responsibilities Perform newborn screening testing on blood spot specimens using immunoassay, enzyme assay, electrophoresis, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), tandem mass spectrometry, and molecular methods. Operate, monitor, and perform daily operation and routine maintenance on laboratory instruments and equipment in accordance with established procedures. Perform calibration of laboratory instruments and assist in troubleshooting instrument and method performance issues. Document and review newborn screening test data, procedures, and results with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. Release test data and reports for use by physicians, health care professionals, and newborn screening medical follow-up teams, ensuring timeliness and accuracy. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures and assist in preparing documentation for test verification and validation studies. Perform quality control and quality assurance procedures in accordance with established standard operating procedures and policies. Recognize basic problems in laboratory methods and performance, document issues, and assist in troubleshooting to resolve them. Assemble and organize quality control data for further analysis, recognize trends or problems, and participate in root cause analysis. Initiate and document corrective actions in response to identified quality issues and contribute to continuous improvement of laboratory processes. Rotate through three separate testing areas, performing assigned testing in one area per shift and moving to a different area on subsequent shifts. Follow all laboratory safety procedures and regulatory requirements while handling specimens, reagents, and equipment. Collaborate with a small overnight team to ensure continuous coverage and timely completion of newborn screening tests. Use downtime productively by engaging in additional training, cross-training in different testing areas, and enhancing technical knowledge. Essential Skills Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Genetics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Eligibility under Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) qualifications for high complexity testing, including at least 6 semesters of Biology and 6 semesters of Chemistry. Job Title: GIS Analyst Job Description The GIS Analyst will support Operation Services, an internal department that aids construction projects. The role involves completing engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for various main and service works, collecting construction activity 'as-built' data with mobile CPS devices in the field, creating permanent asset records, and editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. The analyst will also perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before posting, represent Engineering at project meetings, and conduct field visits to job sites to determine requirements for service and main work. Responsibilities Complete engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS for all types of main and service work. Collect construction activity 'as-built' using mobile CPS devices in the field for creating permanent asset records. Edit map features and correlating attribute data in the GIS. Perform final quality checks on GIS versioned data before it is posted to the GIS. Represent Engineering at internal and external project meetings as required. Visit job sites to determine requirements for service and main work. Perform preliminary reviews of development plans and interface with customers. Implement and train Engineering staff on new work processes for the GIS mapping system. Distribute and update maps for other departments as requested. Approve requests for the acquisition and release of easements and vacation of rights-of-way. Perform pipeline safety compliance-related GIS analysis as directed. Execute all other duties as assigned. Essential Skills Proficiency in ArcGIS and CAD. Knowledge of geography and construction drawings. Experience with as-built drawings, cost forecasting, and drafting. Additional Skills & Qualifications Ability to complete engineering designs and cost estimates using GIS. Experience in collecting construction activity 'as-built' data using mobile CPS devices. Skill in editing map features and correlating attribute data in GIS. Work Environment The role is based in a professional engineering office, initially requiring attendance five days per week, reducing to three days per week after training. Work may be performed in both office and field settings, with exposure to the elements. Typical hours are 7:00 a.m. to 3:45 p.m., Monday through Friday, with potential for overtime and travel. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $25.00 - $27.00/hr. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. Microbiology Lab Analyst Job Description The Microbiology Lab Analyst serves as a Laboratory Technician responsible for performing analytical and microbiological testing on food products, ingredients, and environmental samples to support quality and safety programs. You will apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to ensure accurate, reliable results and help maintain compliance with regulatory and customer requirements. Working primarily on second shift, you will prepare and analyze samples, maintain a clean and organized laboratory, monitor and care for equipment, and assist with inventory and quality-related duties. Responsibilities Perform analytical and microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, and environmental samples in accordance with approved methods and protocols. Apply approved microbiological techniques and methodologies to evaluate indicator organisms, pathogens, and relevant chemistries. Prepare and analyze samples for indicator organisms, pathogens, and chemical parameters, ensuring accuracy and proper documentation. Notify laboratory management promptly of any deviations, out-of-specification results, or unusual findings in test results. Maintain appropriate inventory levels of reagents, media, consumables, and supplies required for testing activities. Provide routine preventive maintenance, basic troubleshooting, and thorough cleaning of laboratory equipment to ensure reliable operation. Support quality-related duties, including performing temperature checks, monitoring controls, and verifying proper storage conditions. Adhere to company policies, procedures, and customer requirements while following relevant regulatory and industry guidelines. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment using proper aseptic techniques and good laboratory practices. Stay current with scientific literature, emerging technologies, and industry trends related to food microbiology and analytical testing. Accurately record, interpret, and report test results in accordance with laboratory documentation standards. Collaborate with colleagues and other departments to support continuous improvement in laboratory processes and quality systems. Essential Skills Bachelor's degree in biology, chemistry, or a closely related science field. At least 2 years of experience in a commercial food-testing or analytical laboratory. Hands-on experience with microbiological testing of food products, ingredients, or environmental samples. Proficiency in aseptic sampling techniques and routine laboratory procedures. Knowledge of laboratory equipment operation, care, and basic troubleshooting. Familiarity with Good Laboratory Practices (GLP). Working knowledge of OSHA safety requirements in a laboratory environment. Experience with FDA, BAM, APHA, ISO, or USP methods relevant to microbiology or analytical testing. Ability to follow detailed protocols and standard operating procedures accurately. Strong attention to detail

Job Title: Molecular Lab Analyst Job Description The Molecular Lab Analyst (Laboratory Analyst II) performs general sample preparation, DNA extractions, and routine PCR and qPCR testing to support GMO analysis of agricultural and food products. This role focuses on executing established testing methods, analyzing and documenting results, troubleshooting laboratory processes, supporting quality systems, and maintaining strict compliance with laboratory procedures and regulatory requirements. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing laboratory operation with modern equipment, diverse projects, and a collaborative, family-style team environment, with potential for full-time employment and holiday pay as part of the contract. Responsibilities Perform quantitative and qualitative GMO testing on corn, soy, and processed food products using established PCR and qPCR methods. Prepare samples, including grinding received agricultural and food product samples, and ensure proper handling and labeling throughout the testing process. Prepare reagents, controls, standards, and PCR plates in accordance with laboratory standard operating procedures (SOPs) and quality standards. Set up and execute PCR and qPCR runs, including manual preparation of reactions without kits, following in-house protocols. Use 96-well plates and transfer to 384-well plates accurately, employing multiple types of pipettes to support high-throughput testing. Analyze test results, perform required calculations, and accurately document findings in laboratory information systems and records. Troubleshoot PCR workflows, instrumentation issues, and testing deviations to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable results. Support nonconformance investigations and root cause analysis activities related to laboratory testing, data integrity, and processes. Perform routine maintenance, calibration checks, and minor repairs on laboratory equipment to maintain optimal performance. Execute and document QA/QC activities in accordance with SOPs, quality systems, and applicable regulatory requirements. Assist with SOP revisions and updates to reflect process improvements and current best practices. Support the training of new laboratory staff on procedures, equipment, and quality requirements. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives within the Quality Management System (QMS) to enhance efficiency and quality. Cross-train in mycotoxin testing using LCMS, following established procedures and quality standards. Lift items up to 25 pounds from floor to ceiling as needed during the shift to support sample handling and laboratory operations. Work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced testing environment, adapting to changing sample flow and priorities. Collaborate with colleagues to maintain a service-oriented, team-focused culture and demonstrate the value of the growing laboratory. Product Support Analyst – Aerospace Job Description This role serves as a customer-facing Product Support Analyst (PSA) embedded onsite with a key aerospace and defense customer in the Denver, Colorado area. You will act as the primary supportability liaison between the customer and engineering, logistics, and program teams based in Ohio. In this position, you support critical aircraft systems and sustainment programs, influence design and lifecycle decisions, and build strong relationships with highly technical customer organizations. The role is ideal for a technically minded professional who communicates clearly, learns complex systems quickly, and collaborates effectively with engineering and program teams. Extensive training, mentoring, and ongoing support are provided for individuals with strong communication skills, technical aptitude, and a willingness to learn. Responsibilities Serve as the primary Supportability Point of Contact (POC) for a major aerospace and defense customer, representing the organization’s product support capabilities onsite. Build and maintain strong relationships with customer engineering, maintenance, and program management teams to ensure effective collaboration and trust. Perform Product Support Analysis (PSA), Logistics Support Analysis (LSA), and supportability assessments to evaluate maintenance concepts, repair strategies, and lifecycle support requirements for aircraft systems. Develop maintenance concepts, support strategies, and sustainment recommendations using PSA and LSA methodologies to optimize system readiness and lifecycle cost. Develop and utilize computer-based models to conduct logistics analysis, functional evaluations, and maintenance planning activities in support of customer programs. Review engineering drawings, schematics, mechanical designs, specifications, and technical documentation to identify supportability impacts and maintenance requirements. Participate in engineering design reviews and collaborate with product development teams to provide supportability-focused recommendations and feedback. Communicate analysis results, findings, and recommendations clearly and professionally to engineering leadership, program managers, and customer stakeholders. Identify support resources, maintenance requirements, and sustainment strategies necessary to maintain system readiness and meet customer performance objectives. Coordinate with internal subject matter experts, engineering teams, and logistics personnel in Ohio to address customer needs and support program deliverables. Manage multiple assignments and priorities simultaneously while adapting to changing customer requirements and program schedules in a fast-paced environment. Function as a trusted onsite representative, building credibility with highly technical customer and engineering organizations through professionalism and technical competence. Job Title: QC Lab Analyst Job Description The QC Lab Analyst supports quality testing activities within a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment that produces personal care, over-the-counter (OTC), and consumer product formulations. In this role, you perform analytical and wet chemistry testing on raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products while ensuring full compliance with FDA and GMP requirements. You contribute directly to product release decisions, method execution, and validation activities, and collaborate closely with Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams. Responsibilities Perform analytical testing using HPLC, GC, and Ion Chromatography (IC) instrumentation to support product release and quality control decisions. Conduct routine wet chemistry and physical testing, including pH, viscosity, density, loss on drying (LOD), color, odor, and appearance measurements. Troubleshoot laboratory instrumentation and assist in resolving equipment issues to minimize downtime and maintain testing accuracy. Document all testing activities accurately and completely in compliance with GMP and FDA requirements, ensuring data integrity and traceability. Review analytical results and communicate findings clearly with Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional departments to support timely decision-making. Support method execution and validation-related activities as needed, contributing to the development and improvement of analytical methods. Participate in cross-training opportunities across analytical, raw materials, and microbiology laboratories to expand capabilities and provide flexible support. Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and laboratory safety guidelines at all times while maintaining a clean, organized, and compliant work area. Work independently on an off-shift schedule while collaborating effectively with a small team of laboratory colleagues. Job Title: Quality Assurance Analyst Job Description The Quality Assurance Analyst ensures that production and sanitation practices in the plant meet all required standards, with a strong focus on compliance with internal quality guidelines as well as USDA and FDA regulations. This role involves auditing processes, collecting and evaluating samples, monitoring packaging and operating practices, and performing product checks to verify that all specifications are consistently met. Responsibilities Audit production practices and sanitation procedures within the plant to verify adherence to established quality and safety standards. Collect assigned chemical, microbiological, and environmental samples according to defined protocols. Examine product packaging to ensure it meets company, USDA, and FDA requirements. Monitor operating practices on the production floor to confirm compliance with regulatory and internal guidelines. Perform product checks to ensure all specifications and quality parameters are consistently met. Issue accurate and timely quality assurance reports based on audits, inspections, and sample results. Place product holds when quality issues are identified and release QA-approved products once specifications and standards are confirmed.
